apps.cmd: rehearsal apps add helpdesk --git https://github.com/you/app --commit 0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567 --image app=you/app:1.4@sha256:<digest> --policies-file policies.txt

build.note: The command prints `job_id`, `world_id`, `world_version_id` and `version`, then one line for each event: the time, the event type and a summary.

worlds.note: A workspace with no world prints `[]`. Each world has a `name`, its `application_id` and its `versions`; each version has an `id`, a `version` number and a `status`.
Each job is printed with its `id`, `slug`, `family`, `split` and `status`.

profiles.note: Each profile is printed with its `id`, `name`, `version` and `created_by`.

eval.note: The command prints `run_id`, `job_id`, `episodes` and `shards`, then one line for each event, then the summary of the run. [Use Rehearsal in CI](/guides/use-rehearsal-in-ci#the-summary-field-by-field) shows the summary's shape.

runs.note: Each episode is printed with its `id`, `scenario`, `split`, `profile`, `status`, `reward` and `termination`.

runs.out:
Error (404): Run run_doesnotexist not found
Check the id: list what exists with 'rehearsal apps list', 'worlds list', 'profiles list' or 'runs show'.

improve.note: The command prints a `job_id`. Follow it with `rehearsal jobs show <job_id>`.

autofix.note: The command prints a `job_id` and the most episodes the loop can run, then follows each round. The result names the best version and its held-out score next to the original's.

gate.note: It prints the run's progress, then a Markdown report, and exits 0 when the change passes, 1 when it fails, and 2 when the run did not finish.
Judges a finished run without starting a new one.

export.note: The command prints a job. The dataset then appears in `rehearsal artifacts list`.

mcp.note: The server talks over standard input and output, so it prints nothing in a terminal. It needs the mcp extra: `pip install 'rehearsal-kit[mcp]'`.

worker.note: Without `--kinds`, the worker takes every kind of work: `world_build`, `world_validate`, `evaluation`, `improvement`, `dataset_export` and `bundle_export`.

Every episode already ends with a verified score from the application's database; today you can export verified episodes as a dataset with `rehearsal export`, and improve an agent's instructions with `rehearsal improve`.
